mapper.sql: select p.project_id, p.project_name, p.project_name_key, p.creator_id, p.create_time, p.update_time from pm_project p
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project (project_name, project_name_key, creator_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{projectName}, #{projectNameKey}, #{creatorId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
